page_title: LIL 3-1 MAR | Lille v Marseille 05/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+5' Today's referee Bastien Dechepy rightly decides to book Jordan Veretout (Marseille) for his harsh tackle.
90+3' That's the end of the game for Benjamin Andre, who is replaced by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille).
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jonathan David walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
88' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Adam Ounas (Lille) replaces Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
88' Today's match ends for Edon Zhegrova who will be replaced by Bafode Diakite (Lille).
84' 3 - 1 Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
83' Here is a change. Amine Harit is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Joaquin Correa (Marseille).
82' Referee Bastien Dechepy points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Marseille players celebrate.
81' Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
81' 2 - 1 Goal! 2:1. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Remy Cabella leaves the pitch and Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) comes on.
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille). Bastien Dechepy doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
77' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

75' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Lucas Chevalier anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
71' 2 - 0 Remy Cabella (Lille) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
70' Bastien Dechepy shows the yellow card to Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) for a heavy challenge.
65' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to substitute Azzedine Ounahi and he is replaced by Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille).
65' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) replacing Luis Henrique.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) will replace Pape Gueye.
65' Leny Yoro (Lille) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
65' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) will take the corner.
60' Flag goes up against Luis Henrique (Marseille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Bastien Dechepy didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
56' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
54' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Pau Lopez into the bottom left corner.
53' Jonathan David (Lille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Bastien Dechepy ignores the protests.
52' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and signals a foul after Samuel Gigot (Marseille) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Lille.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Jordan Veretout (Marseille), comes to nothing.
49' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
47' Remy Cabella (Lille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Alexsandro (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
43' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' The game is interrupted now, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Alexsandro (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Remy Cabella (Lille) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
35' Jonathan David (Lille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. Marseille will take a free kick near the side line.
32' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is flagged for offside.
31' A bullet header by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post.
29' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
28' Tiago Santos (Lille) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Pau Lopez.
28' Remy Cabella (Lille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
27' The foul by Amine Harit (Marseille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Bastien Dechepy.
26' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

25' Alexsandro (Lille) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Pau Lopez pulls off a decent save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
24' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Bastien Dechepy stops the game and makes a call.
23' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.
22' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Jordan Veretout (Marseille) will come up with.
21' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Tiago Santos (Lille), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
21' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle. Quentin Merlin (Marseille) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Lille.
17' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Alexsandro (Lille) goes well wide of the left post.
16' Remy Cabella (Lille) prepares to take a corner kick.
11' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Pau Lopez anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
10' The free kick is delivered by Jordan Veretout (Marseille) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
9' The foul by Jordan Veretout (Marseille) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
6' Jonathan David (Lille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
4' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Edon Zhegrova (Lille), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
3' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lille in a dangerous position.
2' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Lucas Chevalier makes a comfortable save.
1' The first half has started.
Marseille will kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy was nominated as the referee for this game.
